_note:
TARIN on Eastwind Ridge, made unmissable. The scene itself is NOT here: it is the tarin_at_ridge branch of tarin_town in data/events/common.json, which is where every Tarin scene in the game lives, and this only calls it -- see docs/TARIN.md and the note on r3_tarin. The NPC town_tarin sits at 33,5 on the crest with hiddenIfFlag tarin_ridge_done, so he appears and disappears without any script touching him.

THE TRIGGER IS A BAND, four rows deep across the neck of the crest at x=28..32, not a tile on the road. Anything crossing the summit in either direction passes through it: the road is two tiles wide and steps from y4/y5 up to y3/y4 exactly here, and a player who walks the turf beside it still has to get past x=32. Tiles in the band that are solid are simply never stepped on, so a generous band costs nothing.

No onceFlag. onceFlag is set the moment a script starts; this one is gated on tarin_ridge_done instead, which tarin_town sets at the END of the scene, so a player who somehow breaks out of it gets the meeting again rather than losing it.
